title: Cooler MonoCooler (Olympus) — up-only fixed LTV oracle: no live E-U, 41.6% price gap to re-arm
closed_reasons: oracle 3,119.289 USDS/gOHM vs gOHM market 5,337.30 = 58.44% of market; borrowing 100% of oracle loses 41.56% (-$2,218.01 per gOHM)
all 328 borrowing accounts enumerated from 9,020 Borrow events: 0 above LLTV (3,150.482), 0 above OLTV (3,119.289), max LTV 3,118.439
liquidations use only the internal up-only oracle (no market price input), so no position can be liquidated on a market crash and the free-collateral batchLiquidate path is unreachable
DLGTE mutators are kernel-permissioned; withdrawCollateral re-checks LTV after the state write; authorization is signature/nonce-bound
oracle setters are onlyAdminRole and can only increase (CannotDecreaseLtv)
key_facts: OLTV ramp 2,989.652 (2026-04-25) -> 3,123.183 (2026-10-27), slope +0.7252/day; governance can add up to 500/call at <=100/day with a 7-day lead, never decrease
oracle = 58.44% of market; trigger requires a 41.56% gOHM drawdown (OHM to ~$11.586 at index 269.2385)
treasury sUSDS headroom 3,238,435 sUSDS = 3,606,287.84 USDS; existing borrowers have 2,217,856 USDS of pre-authorised top-up room
largest borrower = OrigamiHOhmManager 0xe6C5dc8508939B1c417f83B7fed3149ef22cF3Ff: 23,417.01 gOHM / 73,024,516.73 USDS at LTV 3,118.439 (55.7% of collateral, 56.6% of debt)
conditional E-U if gOHM < oracle: 3.606M x (1 - P/3,119.289); 715k at P=2,500, 1.29M at P=2,000, 1.87M at P=1,500, ceiling 3.61M at P=0; fresh attacker residual ~1.39M if incumbents top up first
LLTV-OLTV gap 100 bps means a max-LTV position needs ~2.00 years of 0.49875%/yr accrual to become liquidatable
caveats: gOHM market price is a DefiLlama aggregate (confidence 1.0, index x OHM price); DEX slippage for a multi-million gOHM acquisition via OHM staking is estimated, not simulated
treasury headroom is the binding constraint today and can be topped up by Olympus governance, so the conditional ceiling is a point-in-time number
no mainnet transaction was signed or sent; all verification is eth_call plus a pinned-block Foundry fork
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Cooler MonoCooler: the up-only oracle prices gOHM 41.6% below market, all 328 accounts are above water, and liquidation is impossible without debt growth; the latent $(3.61M x (1 - P/3,119.289)) re-arms only if gOHM falls below $3,119.
